name: my-os
description: MY OS — Personal Command Center by SmartDevCo

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w frontend
scripts.deploy:web: npm run build -w frontend && npx firebase-tools deploy --only hosting --project sdc-todomanagement
